_readme: Each entry is one manager/franchise. 'swid' links to the owners table in fantasy_league.db when known (leave null if unknown — team_id continuity across years, confirmed via ESPN's league-history/members page or by cross-checking the DB, is also a valid way to link a manager even without a SWID). 'team_aliases' lists every team name this manager has used, by year — used to compute their all-time record. 'claimed' controls what the site shows: true = display_name is a real name and renders on the page; false = the site shows a neutral 'Unclaimed Franchise' label instead (display_name/_internal_note stay in this file for your own reference, they just don't render). Flip 'claimed' to true once you fill in a real display_name. 'bio' and 'inside_joke' only render when site_src/content/league_info.json's section_visibility.show_manager_bios is true (currently off — see CONTENT_TODO.md).
